newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slipped in early morning trade following a jump of over two percent in the key Nikkei average on the previous day, brokers said.
They said the downside was likely to be limited by bargain hunting.
After 21 minutes of trade, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 134.62 points or 0.66 percent at 20,216.72. Its June futures fell 140 to 20,260.

"Telecoms, wire and cable companies are sluggish and the high techs which were bought yesterday are a bit feeble," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said. "There is little else to buy and investors are sidelined."
